theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_tpr_hausdorff_null_of_weight_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (Z : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → μ Z = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → μHE[n] Z = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
